subject.title: feat: add devcontainer for cross-platform development

question: Should OpenClaw own a first-party VS Code devcontainer that preinstalls GitHub CLI and Claude tooling, or should this be narrowed to a generic Node/pnpm contributor container before merge?
rationale: The code blockers are repairable, but the permanent developer-environment surface and bundled external AI tooling are a maintainer ownership choice.

options.title: Narrow and repair before merge
options.body: Keep the devcontainer idea, but pin or remove mutable executable inputs and use valid labeler wiring before a maintainer makes the final merge call.

options.title: Accept full tool bundle after hardening
options.body: Own the GitHub CLI and Claude CLI bundle as first-party setup once every external executable input is pinned and documented.

options.title: Pause or close as out of scope
options.body: Decline first-party devcontainer ownership and ask contributors to use the existing Docker/source docs instead.

recommendation.title: Narrow and repair before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the devcontainer idea, but pin or remove mutable executable inputs and use valid labeler wiring before a maintainer makes the final merge call.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the clearest combined history across prior devcontainer context, Docker setup, and labeler-adjacent files.
